title: RBI to conduct Second 3-day Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under LAF on July 17, 2026
description: On a review of current and evolving liquidity conditions, it has been decided to conduct a Second Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction on Friday, July 17, 2026, as under: Sl. No. Notified Amount (₹ crore) Tenor (day) Window Timing Date of Reversal 1 50,000 3 10:45 AM to 11:15 AM July 20, 2026 (Monday) 2. The operational guidelines for the auction will be same as given in Reserve Bank’s Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.Ajit Prasad      &nbs
